profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, labeled BT Radianz: 492 River Road with operator bt, sits in Essex County, New Jersey, close to the Nutley and Clifton area. Radianz was originally formed as a joint venture, providing a shared low latency financial extranet connecting banks, exchanges, and financial services firms to reduce the cost and complexity of maintaining separate point to point network connections for market data and trading; BT, the British telecommunications company formally known as BT Group, acquired the Radianz business in 2005 and rebranded it BT Radianz, continuing to operate it as part of BTs financial services connectivity offerings. reading: BT Group plc, generally known simply as BT and historically as British Telecom, is a UK-headquartered global telecommunications company listed on the London Stock Exchange under ticker BT.A and available to US investors as an American Depositary Receipt under ticker BT. In the United States, BT operates a New Jersey facility at 492 River Road in Nutley, near Newark, associated with BT Radianz, the low-latency financial services extranet BT operates for trading firms and exchanges, alongside broader BT Americas network and colocation infrastructure. Unlike the wholesale and hyperscale operators elsewhere in this registry, BT's core business is telecommunications and managed network services rather than leasing data center space to enterprise tenants, so its New Jersey facility functions primarily as network infrastructure and a point of presence supporting BT's own service delivery and its financial industry extranet customers rather than as a standalone commercial colocation product. As a UK-listed multinational rather than a US-domiciled company, BT does not file 10-K reports with the SEC, and its facility-level disclosure in the United States is limited relative to US-listed operators in this registry.
